title: Entry after a list drop
statement: Let $E$ and $r$ be finite bit strings, let $p$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a bit. If removing the first $p$ bits of $E$ gives $b$ followed by $r$, then the bit of $E$ at position $p$, with out-of-range positions read as $0$, is $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ with its first $p$ entries removed equals $b$ followed by $r$
